name: Editor mode
description: A role pack for the solo author or small editorial team filling the kit with their own subject: six kit-blind jobs along the editorial chain — article-draft, glossary-entry, source-wiring, style-pass, variants-brief, release-check — each producing a markdown artifact in the author's manifest language (shipped examples are German) under the pack's guardrails (no invented sources, draft stamp until a human has checked, no third-party text into CC BY content, publishing stays human). Activate it conversationally ('switch to editor mode').

phrases: help me get this ready to publish
hilf mir, einen Artikel zu schreiben
hilf mir, das zum Veröffentlichen fertig zu machen
activation.note: Conversational and in-place — no install. The agent announces the switch, names the six jobs and where the chain usually starts (article-draft or glossary-entry). Leaving the mode is just as conversational.

capabilities.purpose: Hand a finished draft to the kit's own article builder; read existing articles for style-pass and release-check.
Link existing terms instead of redefining them; hand a finished entry to the kit's glossary builder.
Include dated events in variants-brief and release-check (title rule, source per mention).
Place the generic source records of a source map into the kit's source layer when the kit declares one; otherwise the records stay in the markdown map.
Place the release-check's news draft into the kit's news layer when the kit declares one; otherwise the draft stays in the preflight file.
Advice on sentence length and long words for Easy-Language variants in style-pass and release-check; without it, sentence length is judged by eye and the review says no measure ran.
